content: dotnet/runtime ran 878 Copilot coding agent PRs over 10 months, 535 merged (67.9%). Success by task type: removal 84.7%, testing 75.6%, refactor 69.7%, bugfix 69.4%, docs 68.1%, features 64.5%, perf 54.5%. Adding copilot-instructions.md with build commands + firewall allowlist raised success 38% to 69%. Merged agent PRs averaged 16.5 review comments vs 12.4 human. 52.3% of merged agent PRs needed direct human commits; those succeeded 86.2% vs 55.1% fully autonomous. Review capacity is the bottleneck. Rule adopted: no autonomous merging. Agent laziness: optimizes for the literal request, will not infer broader goals.
